simplesect.para: the number of wait states before another MFMA instruction can be issued after MI.

briefdescription.para: Pad the latency between neighboring MFMA instructions with s_nops.

detaileddescription.para: The percentage of wait states to fill with s_nops is specified by the command line option '-amdgpu-mfma-padding-ratio'.
2 pass MFMA instructions have a latency of 2 wait states. Therefore, a 'S_NOP 1' will be added between sequential MFMA instructions.

briefdescription.para: atIssueLimit - Return true if no more instructions may be issued in this cycle.

detaileddescription.para: FIXME: remove this once MachineScheduler is the only client.

briefdescription.para: EmitInstruction - This callback is invoked when an instruction is emitted, to advance the hazard state.
This overload will be used when the hazard recognizer is being used by a non-scheduling pass, which does not use SUnits.
getHazardType - Return the hazard type of emitting this node.

detaileddescription.para:
There are three possible results. Either:
NoHazard: it is legal to issue this instruction on this cycle.
Hazard: issuing this instruction would stall the machine. If some other instruction is available, issue it first.
NoopHazard: issuing this instruction would break the program. If some other instruction can be issued, do so, otherwise issue a noop.

briefdescription.para: EmitNoop - This callback is invoked when a noop was added to the instruction stream.
This overload will be used when the hazard recognizer is being used by a non-scheduling pass, which does not use SUnits.
AdvanceCycle - This callback is invoked whenever the next top-down instruction to be scheduled cannot issue in the current cycle, either because of latency or resource conflicts.

detaileddescription.para: This should increment the internal state of the hazard recognizer so that previously "Hazard" instructions will now not be hazards.

briefdescription.para: RecedeCycle - This callback is invoked whenever the next bottom-up instruction to be scheduled cannot issue in the current cycle, either because of latency or resource conflicts.
ShouldPreferAnother - This callback may be invoked if getHazardType returns NoHazard.

detaileddescription.para: If, even though there is no hazard, it would be better to schedule another available instruction, this callback should return true.

briefdescription.para: Reset - This callback is invoked when a new block of instructions is about to be schedule.

detaileddescription.para: The hazard state should be set to an initialized state.
